service.en: Exit fee at land and sea ports
service.ar: رسوم المغادرة في المنافذ البرية والبحرية
service.ur: زمینی اور سمندری بندرگاہوں پر روانگی فیس

about: Pay the fee for leaving the UAE through a land or sea port.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Exit fee at land and sea ports. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: For residents and visitors holding a residence file or a visa
UAE nationals, GCC citizens and people arriving on a tourist ferry are exempt
timing: The page gives no processing time
channels: ICP Smart Services website (sign in with UAE PASS)
